catalog.title: Insurance authorization information
catalog.description: Administrative support for denied or delayed insurance authorization.

passages.text: Insurance authorization requests with denied coverage or delay may be routed to a human administrative reviewer.
Urgent authorization inquiries require human review; this information does not approve coverage or recommend treatment.
Appointment scheduling information is available from a human scheduling coordinator.
